task: ADR-034 (PMBOK Tooling Decommissioning and Lightweight LearningStore Convergence): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Decommissions shadow SQLite/FastAPI/Typer/OCR stack in favor of LearningStore (ADR-002 Invariant #2, Zero Entity Sprawl); converges PMBOK lifecycle state onto Episode records with cross-references to authoritative governance episodes under agent-learning-governance; enforces Inversion of Control with a pure domain package agent_learning.pmbok (zero storage imports, zero network I/O, zero time.sleep) and isolated runtime harness agent_learning.pmbok_runtime; unifies CLI entry point under agent-learn pmbok with batch review unrolling per-plan accountability (ADR-013 §4.2); implements auditable approval verification with latest-wins ordering (created_at, sequence_number), human-accepted disposition checks (decision_disposition: accepted), recursive effective-upstream bypass for not_applicable nodes, and transitive DAG staleness validation across full_plan and staged pmp_section routes; designates ADR-034 §4.3.1 as the authoritative frontmatter grammar standard with fail-closed governance law (fourth Technical Integrity Hard Block); enforces audit-data minimalism (Invariant 6).

Five real alternatives named and rejected with explicit rationales: adding heavy packages to base dependencies, optional extras, stdlib sqlite3 rewrite, removing PMBOK orchestration entirely, and declaring pyyaml runtime dependency.

Honest disclosure of positive benefits (zero entity sprawl, permanent resolution of LL-013, 100% clean test collection, lightweight embeddable library) against negative trade-offs (permanent decommissioning of embedded FastAPI server and OCR ingestion, four-phase refactoring burden for Epic 12, parser maintenance overhead in agent_learning.pmbok); complete errata and carried-over item tracker in §8.1 with assigned owners and milestones.

Implementation specifics and scope cleanly bounded: legacy 49-process registry explicitly designated as 6th-edition process bridge mapped to ADR-012 legacy_process; PMBOK 8 40-process model scoped as future enhancement; concrete four-phase implementation sequencing with auditable completion criteria; normative 6-scenario test suite specification; explicit derivation logic for all seven plan lifecycle states with in-flight review and local edit precedence.
